messages:
Maya K: Thanks for joining the live Q&A. Two quick asks from leadership: 1) clear one-line summary of the runtime performance goals for Q2; 2) any feature flags we should warn support about?
Ibrahim N: TL;DR for Q2: reduce median token latency by 10% across hosted models, cap p95 regressions to <5% for Dedicated via fallbacks, and enable adaptive batching prototype.
Priya S: Can you spell out what "adaptive batching" means for PMs? They're worried about customer-visible knobs.
Ibrahim N: Sure. Adaptive batching = runtime adjusts batch_window_ms based on recent sequence length distribution and observed queue depth. Customers won't need to change calls; we'll expose an opt-in alpha knob in the route config.
Sam (infra): What's the rollout plan? Canary -> staged -> all-hosted? Any extra infra costs?
Ibrahim N: Canary in one region (us-west-2) for two days with traffic shadowing, then staged rollouts over two weeks. Extra infra cost limited to perf harness and canary pool (small GPU reservation).
Priya S: Product wants exact phrasing for release notes: benefits, risks, and the opt-in config. Who can draft?
Ibrahim N: I'll draft a short blurb. Sample: "Runtime microbatching & adaptive batching (alpha): expected ~8-12% p50 latency reduction on text-gen; p95 improvements depend on KV cache hit rate. Opt-in route config: {\"adaptive_batching\": true, \"batch_window_ms\": 10}. Possible regressions on very short prompt workloads; fallback policy enabled."
Kala R: Ops question: how will we detect regressions quickly in canary so SRE can roll back? Need a concrete alert plan.
Ibrahim N: Good call. We'll add canary-specific dashboards + anomaly detector on latency noise. If p95 increases >7% for 30m vs baseline, trigger a rollback runbook.
Sam (infra): @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary rollout job and attach the runbook?
deploy-bot: Scheduled job deploy/canary/2734567890 with runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/canary-rollback. Watch window: 48h.
Maya K: Also, leadership asked about kernel-level regressions from attention-fusion v5. Any outstanding blockers?
Ibrahim N: Attention-fusion v5 improves throughput but has a bug on some 4-bit quant paths; kernel team provided a fallback path that keeps p50 stable but loses ~4% throughput. Plan: ship fallback in canary, fix quant path in v5.1.
Priya S: Product follow-up: will any API breaking change be needed?
Ibrahim N: No API changes. Only route config alpha keys for opt-in. Defaults remain unchanged.
Kala R: I'll add canary alert rules to the SLO dashboard and coordinate on-call. Assigning ticket RNW-1984 for alert config changes.
Maya K: Thanks. Final ask: can someone list 3 bullets for PMs they can paste into customer comms?
Priya S: I'll take it and combine with Ibrahim's blurb. Draft due tomorrow EOD.
Ibrahim N: I'll post perf numbers and raw harness results in this thread once the canary job completes.
Maya K: Great. If any Dedicated customer raised concerns, route to priority-support and we'll pause rollout for that account. Closing thread; will post minutes in the all-hands doc.
